title: LTX 2.3 image to video
description: Bring a picture to life as a clip with sound, made by LTX 2.3 (distilled, 8 steps). The picture is the first frame. 5 seconds by default, up to 10.

evidence: 2026-11-16: graph taken from the ltx_graph builder of the pipeline-ia-terraform worker (PinkCherry v1.8 full checkpoint, Gemma heretic fp8 text encoder, distilled LoRA 0.6, 8 manual sigmas, euler, cfg 1), which runs on the same ComfyUI v0.45.3 server. Changes: example prompt emptied, lossless tail-frame save removed, seconds control feeding 8n+1 frames at 24 fps, portrait/landscape switch (704x1280 or 1280x704). Not run from this repository.

licenses.software: Graph: from the pipeline-ia-terraform worker. ComfyUI core: GPL-3.0. ComfyUI-LTXVideo node pack: license as published in its repository, not reviewed here.
